REPORT

US Data Center Gas Outlook 2035: On-Site Plants Boom

Data Centers

Published on September 14, 2026

Executive summary

Natural gas is set to play a critical role in meeting data center power demand. It will supply about 69% of power needed by new grid-connected facilities in BNEF’s various scenarios. On-site gas generation adds further demand as developers seek faster energization.
Data center power demand is projected to reach 194 gigawatts by 2035 – making the power sector the second-largest driver of US natural gas demand growth through 2035, behind liquefied natural gas (LNG) exports – increasing pressure on gas producers to scale supply.

By the numbers

50%

Growth in 2035 power sector gas consumption relative to 2025 levels

2.9 - 3.4 Bcf/d

Potential on-site gas demand by 2035 under BNEF’s scenarios

194GW

Installed data center power capacity by 2035 versus 47GW in 2025
